# Image and graphic proofs – version 0.2.0

## Editorial vector illustration

werk.svg: specially created illustration of fictitious letters, book pages and notes. Editable source code included. No reproduction of historical sources.

## Three additional scenes

Created with the built-in image generation tool, October 20, 2026. All persons, sources and situations are illustrative and fictitious; no authentic project portraits and no software screenshots. Original files were copied to the project unchanged.

- [sources.webp](sources. webp): joint work on letter and book.
- [detectiv.webp](detective.webp): Samir compares corrections. Use in the structured PM history. The screen display is not a real CodeScene interface.
- [edaktion.webp](redaktion. webp): Conversation with the publisher.

### Prompt source.webp

Create a wide landscape editorial illustration 3:2 for a German digital scholarly editions educational website. Warm hand painted gouache and colored pencil, textured ivory paper, muted sage, slate blue and terracotta, sophisticated contemporary magazine style. Two present-day scholars at a shared wooden desk comparing a historic letter facsimile and annotated old printed volume. One woman early forties short dark hair rust cardion, one man late thirties short dark hair olive shirt, relaxed thoughtful absorbed collaboration. Shelves and source folders, no grand fantasy library, humane natural daylight. Historical manuscripts purely fictitious and notifying words no words no words, no words no phrases no words.

### Prompt detective.webp

Create a wide landscape editorial illustration 3:2, warm gouache and colored pencil on textured ivory, muted sage slate blue terracotta. Contemporary scholarly editor Samir, man late thirties short dark hair olive shirt, investigates a puzzle chain of corrections. At desk with three printed proof sheets and small colored removable markers showing matching note anchors, he compares sheets with a laptop showing an abstract heatmap of rectangles, no legible UI. Face curious, detective-like concentration without costume or crime clichés. Books, daylight, humane editorial magazine composition. No text labels numeric, detective concentration with unknown costume or crimes.

### Prompt editorial.webp

Create wide landscape editorial illustration 3:2 for digital scholarly editions website. Warm sophisticated gouache and colored pencil, textured ivory, muted sage slate blue and terracotta. Small contemporary publishing meeting around a table: woman editor short dark hair rust cardigan, woman publisher in slate blue jacket with printed book proof, man technical editor olive shirt, another woman college raise a thoughtful challenging question. Papers, proof pages and a single printed volume, expressions mixed committed and concerned, no villain or triumphant character. Human scale, airy daylight, inspecting issue, expressive editor magazine.

## Information graphics

Decision graph: own SVG template in decision-graph.js; neutral resource entscheidungen.svg and current selection from the same template. Architecture, model change, approval, manifesto and process view are native HTML/CSS graphics. Sources and classification: see [Research](../recherche.md). No empirical measured values shown.
